notes: All 54 generation cells completed. Every objective gate is no_gate in both campaigns, so scores are judge evidence, not test-pass rates.
The original 36-cell campaign uses one sample per judge; the 18-cell mixed-workflow follow-up uses three samples per judge and completed all adversarial deliberations.

Efficiency uses each campaign's serialized generation telemetry. Five Sol → Terra follow-up cells have recomputed API-equivalent costs; Grok workflows keep cost unknown because Grok usage telemetry is unavailable.
The mixed Opus → Codex estimate is $115.5829 across six cells: $67.3351 Codex 5.5, $47.6319 Opus 4.8, and $0.6159 Haiku utility calls, or $19.26 per task on average.
Grok workflows publish explicitly partial Sol-only token subtotals where retained Sol events are complete. These are not full-workflow totals, and no Grok tokens are imputed.
Wall-time means use only recorded samples. Recovered follow-up artifacts preserve scores and patches but not original wall time.
Costs use the benchmark's versioned 2026-06 usual-tier table and are API-equivalent estimates, not subscription invoices; judge usage is excluded.
The site's machine-readable snapshot contains all follow-up score samples and intervals; the 18 follow-up patches are not yet in the public raw-evidence bundle.
